licenses.text:
Η Καινή Διαθήκη, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/grc-tisch/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/grc-tisch/copyright.htm):
> The New Testament in Koine Greek, based on Tischendorf's 8th edition
> Public Domain
> Language: Ελληνικά (Greek, Ancient)
> Dialect: Koine
> Translation by: Tischendorf, etc.
> Tischendorf's 8th edition Greek New Testament
> with morphological tags
> Version 2.7
> Based on G. Clint Yale's Tischendorf text
> and on Dr. Maurice A. Robinson's
> Public Domain Westcott-Hort text
> Edited by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen
> This text and its analysis are
> in the Public Domain. Copy freely.
> 2014-01-11

What was found:
Text: Tischendorf's 8th edition (Leipzig 1869-72; Tischendorf died 1874), version 2.7, base text supplied by G. Clint Yale, analysis by Maurice Robinson, edited by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen.

Why it stays out: missing fact: G. Clint Yale's own public-domain statement for the accented base text (the editor only reports Yale's permission).

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grc-tisch), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grc-tisch/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constantin_von_Tischendorf; https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grc-tisch.
